item: launch.sh no longer sends the server a SIGTERM beside the terminal's SIGINT
summary: One Ctrl-C reached the server twice (the terminal's SIGINT to the group, and the launcher trap's SIGTERM); when the TERM won, uvicorn read the SIGINT as a second Ctrl-C and skipped the lifespan shutdown (3 of 14 runs; the next boot read it as an unclean end, identical to a SIGKILL). INT is no longer forwarded, TERM and HUP still are once, and the launcher waits for the server to end. tests/test_launcher_signals.py forces TERM then INT against real uvicorn: red with the old trap.
